Hey goats, loving the site so far, but here's my initial thoughts.

  • Voting restrictions make no sense. I haven't heard a single good reason why we should be restricting voting, when that's the entire point of the site. After I hit my upvotes limit, I got bored and headed back over to reddit. I commented some things even though I had nothing to say, but it had no effect on my ability to vote again.

  • Why would you want to deter lurkers? They eventually become contributors, but with restrictions on their participation, they'll probably get bored like I did.

  • Why restrict down voting? Take a look at any commenting system without it, like YouTube comments. You'll end up with some pretty crazy stuff up top.

  • I shouldn't have to keep track of how many votes I have left... O just want to up or downvotes things I like or dislike.
It isn't to deter you from voting it's too deter people from creating multiple accounts and spam voting. Once you meet the preset criteria it'll be similar to reddit.
I'd upvote your post if i could.

Downvoating restrictions make sense, since that is how the site buries stuff and can be tantamount to censor if used badly. Downvoating is supposed to be for spam and thread hijacks, not "I disagree."

I'm with you on the upvoating, though. It's not very transparent and pretty heavy-handed when it kicks in.

Reddit can be influenced by massive upvoting. So people took advantage of that by spamming votes within the first 5 minutes which would increase the visibility of the post. So upvote limits make sense as well so people don't leverage multiple accounts to increase visibility/popularity of those posts.
